mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (user_id, acorn_amount, price, status, order_uid, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{acornAmount}, #{price}, #{status}, #{orderUid}, now())
mapper.select: SELECT order_id, user_id, acorn_amount, price, status, order_uid, created_at, updated_at FROM orders WHERE order_uid = #{orderUid} FOR UPDATE
SELECT order_id, user_id, acorn_amount, price, status, order_uid, created_at, updated_at FROM orders WHERE order_id = #{orderId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status = #{status}, updated_at = now() WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment (order_id, pg_tx_id, method, amount, status, pg_status, user_id, paid_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{pgTxId}, #{method}, #{amount}, 'DONE', #{pgStatus}, #{userId}, now(), now()) ON CONFLICT (order_id) WHERE order_id IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE payment SET pg_status = #{pgStatus}, failure_code = #{failureCode}, updated_at = now() WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
mapper.select: SELECT pg_tx_id FROM payment WHERE order_id = #{orderId} LIMIT 1
SELECT wallet_id, user_id, balance, reserved_balance FROM acorn_wallet WHERE user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO acorn_wallet (user_id, balance, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, 0, now()) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE acorn_wallet SET balance = balance + #{amount}, updated_at = now() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE acorn_wallet SET reserved_balance = reserved_balance + #{amount}, updated_at = now() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE acorn_wallet SET reserved_balance = GREATEST(reserved_balance - #{amount}, 0), updated_at = now() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO acorn_transaction (user_id, amount, balance_after, reason, ref_id, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{amount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{reason}, #{refId}, now()) ON CONFLICT (ref_id, reason) WHERE ref_id IS NOT NULL AND reason IN ('CHARGE', 'REFUND') DO NOTHING
